definition: a formal greeting used when you meet someone for the first time; the other person usually answers with the same words
translation: rất hân hạnh được gặp (câu chào trang trọng khi mới gặp)
exampleSentence: How do you do? I'm Anna Clark.
exampleTranslation: Xin chào, rất hân hạnh. Tôi là Anna Clark.

definition: a friendly greeting used when you meet someone for the first time
exampleSentence: Nice to meet you. I've heard a lot about you.
exampleTranslation: Rất vui được gặp bạn. Tôi nghe nói về bạn nhiều rồi.

definition: a humorous way to say hello to someone you have not seen for a long time
exampleSentence: Long time no see! How have you been?
exampleTranslation: Lâu quá không gặp! Dạo này bạn thế nào?

definition: an informal way to ask why something happened, especially when you are surprised
translation: sao lại, tại sao lại (hỏi khi ngạc nhiên)
exampleSentence: How come you're still here? I thought you'd left.
exampleTranslation: Sao bạn vẫn còn ở đây? Tôi tưởng bạn đi rồi.

definition: something you say when saying goodbye to family and friends
translation: giữ gìn sức khỏe nhé, bảo trọng
exampleSentence: Take care! See you next week.
exampleTranslation: Bảo trọng nhé! Hẹn gặp tuần sau.

definition: used to say goodbye, especially to customers leaving a shop or restaurant; more common in American English
exampleSentence: Here's your receipt. Have a nice day!
exampleTranslation: Hóa đơn của bạn đây ạ. Chúc bạn một ngày tốt lành!

definition: used to say that you hope someone will be successful
exampleSentence: Good luck with your interview tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Chúc bạn phỏng vấn ngày mai may mắn.

definition: used in cards and letters to say you hope someone will be happy, successful or healthy
translation: xin gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp nhất
exampleSentence: Best wishes for the new year.
exampleTranslation: Gửi bạn những lời chúc tốt đẹp nhất cho năm mới.

definition: what you say to someone who has just sneezed
translation: chúc bạn khỏe (nói khi ai đó vừa hắt hơi)
exampleSentence: "Achoo!" "Bless you!"
exampleTranslation: "Hắt xì!" "Chúc bạn khỏe!"

definition: used to get someone's attention politely, especially before you ask a question
exampleSentence: Excuse me, where is the nearest bank?
exampleTranslation: Xin lỗi, cho tôi hỏi ngân hàng gần nhất ở đâu ạ?

definition: used to say sorry politely when you have bumped into or interrupted someone by accident
translation: xin lỗi (khi lỡ va vào hoặc ngắt lời ai)
exampleSentence: Oh, pardon me. I didn't see you there.
exampleTranslation: Ôi, xin lỗi. Tôi không thấy bạn đứng đó.

definition: a polite way to ask someone to repeat what they have just said
translation: xin lỗi, bạn nói gì ạ? (nhờ nhắc lại một cách lịch sự)
exampleSentence: I beg your pardon? I didn't catch that.
exampleTranslation: Xin lỗi, bạn nói gì ạ? Tôi nghe chưa rõ.

definition: an informal way to say you made a mistake or that something is your fault
exampleSentence: Oh, my bad. I sent it to the wrong person.
exampleTranslation: À, lỗi của tôi. Tôi gửi nhầm người rồi.

definition: used to answer when someone thanks you or says sorry
translation: không có gì, không sao đâu
exampleSentence: "Thanks for the ride." "No problem."
exampleTranslation: "Cảm ơn đã cho đi nhờ nhé." "Không có gì."

definition: used to agree to a request and say that it is not a problem; mainly British and Australian
translation: không sao đâu, cứ yên tâm
exampleSentence: "Can you send it today?" "No worries."
exampleTranslation: "Hôm nay bạn gửi được không?" "Được chứ, cứ yên tâm."

definition: a polite way to say there is no need to thank you
translation: đừng khách sáo, không có gì
exampleSentence: "Thank you so much for your help." "Don't mention it."
exampleTranslation: "Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã giúp." "Đừng khách sáo."

definition: a polite reply when someone thanks you
translation: không có gì, rất sẵn lòng
exampleSentence: "Thanks for dinner." "You're welcome."
exampleTranslation: "Cảm ơn bữa tối nhé." "Không có gì."

definition: a very polite and old-fashioned way of saying thank you
translation: rất cảm ơn (cách nói trang trọng, hơi cổ)
exampleSentence: Much obliged for your kindness.
exampleTranslation: Rất cảm ơn lòng tốt của bạn.

definition: used to give someone permission to do what they have asked to do
exampleSentence: "May I borrow your pen?" "Be my guest."
exampleTranslation: "Cho tôi mượn bút được không?" "Cứ tự nhiên."

definition: to take what you want without asking permission, used especially when offering food
translation: cứ tự nhiên lấy, mời bạn dùng
exampleSentence: There's plenty of food, so help yourself.
exampleTranslation: Còn nhiều đồ ăn lắm, bạn cứ tự nhiên lấy nhé.

definition: used to tell a visitor to relax as if they were in their own home
translation: cứ tự nhiên như ở nhà
exampleSentence: Come in and make yourself at home.
exampleTranslation: Mời vào, cứ tự nhiên như ở nhà nhé.

definition: used when you give something to someone
exampleSentence: Here you are. Two coffees.
exampleTranslation: Của bạn đây ạ. Hai ly cà phê.

definition: used when you give something to someone
exampleSentence: Here you go. That's your change.
exampleTranslation: Đây nhé. Tiền thối của bạn.

definition: used to ask someone to wait for a short time while you do something
exampleSentence: Just a moment, please. I'll check the file.
exampleTranslation: Xin chờ một chút. Tôi sẽ kiểm tra tập tin.

definition: used when someone you have just been talking about appears
exampleSentence: Speak of the devil! We were just talking about you.
exampleTranslation: Vừa nhắc là tới! Bọn tôi đang nói về bạn đây.

definition: used to wish someone happiness on their birthday
exampleSentence: Happy birthday, Tom! Make a wish.
exampleTranslation: Chúc mừng sinh nhật, Tom! Ước đi nào.

definition: used to wish someone happiness at the start of a new year
exampleSentence: Happy New Year! Let's hope it's a good one.
exampleTranslation: Chúc mừng năm mới! Hy vọng đây là một năm tốt đẹp.

definition: used to praise someone for doing something very well
exampleSentence: Well done! You passed the test.
exampleTranslation: Làm tốt lắm! Bạn đã đỗ bài kiểm tra rồi.

definition: used to tell someone they have done something very well; American English
exampleSentence: You got the job? Way to go!
exampleTranslation: Bạn được nhận rồi à? Giỏi quá!

definition: said before bed, especially to a child, to say you hope they sleep well
exampleSentence: Good night, sweetie. Sleep tight!
exampleTranslation: Chúc con ngủ ngon. Ngủ thật ngon nhé!

definition: said to someone before they start a meal, to say you hope they enjoy it
exampleSentence: Dinner is ready. Bon appetit!
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối xong rồi. Chúc mọi người ăn ngon miệng!

definition: used to wish someone a happy birthday
exampleSentence: Many happy returns, Grandma!
exampleTranslation: Chúc bà sinh nhật vui vẻ!

definition: an informal way to tell someone to be careful
exampleSentence: Watch out! There's a car coming.
exampleTranslation: Coi chừng! Có xe đang tới.

definition: used to say you feel the same as someone else
exampleSentence: "I'm exhausted." "Same here."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi mệt rã rời." "Tôi cũng vậy."

definition: used to agree with a negative statement that someone has just made
exampleSentence: "I don't like horror films." "Me neither."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi không thích phim kinh dị." "Tôi cũng không."

definition: used as a reply to a greeting or good wish
exampleSentence: "Merry Christmas!" "The same to you!"
exampleTranslation: "Chúc Giáng sinh vui vẻ!" "Bạn cũng vậy nhé!"

definition: used to tell someone not to worry or be upset about something
translation: đừng bận tâm, không sao đâu
exampleSentence: Never mind. We can try again tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Đừng bận tâm. Mai mình thử lại.

definition: used to emphasize that you will not agree or will not be able to do something
translation: không đời nào, không thể nào
exampleSentence: "Can you lend me your car?" "No way!"
exampleTranslation: "Cho tôi mượn xe được không?" "Không đời nào!"

definition: used to emphasize that you agree with someone or are keen to do what they suggest
exampleSentence: "Are you coming to the party?" "You bet!"
exampleTranslation: "Bạn đến dự tiệc chứ?" "Chắc chắn rồi!"

definition: used to say yes or to give permission politely
exampleSentence: "Can I use your phone?" "Of course."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi dùng điện thoại của bạn được không?" "Tất nhiên rồi."

definition: used to say very strongly that something is not true or correct
exampleSentence: "Do you mind if I open the window?" "Of course not."
exampleTranslation: "Tôi mở cửa sổ có phiền bạn không?" "Tất nhiên là không."

definition: a polite reply when someone has thanked you or asked if you mind doing something; mainly British English
translation: không có gì, không phiền chút nào
exampleSentence: "Do you mind waiting?" "Not at all."
exampleTranslation: "Bạn chờ một chút có phiền không?" "Không phiền chút nào."

definition: used to say "no" or "not" in a less strong way
exampleSentence: "Did you enjoy the film?" "Not really."
exampleTranslation: "Bạn có thích bộ phim không?" "Không hẳn."

definition: used to agree with a statement or question, but without being sure or enthusiastic
translation: chắc là vậy, tôi đoán thế
exampleSentence: "Is it going to rain?" "I guess so."
exampleTranslation: "Trời sắp mưa à?" "Chắc là vậy."

definition: used to say that you hope something that has been mentioned will happen or is true
exampleSentence: "Will the train be on time?" "I hope so."
exampleTranslation: "Tàu sẽ đến đúng giờ chứ?" "Hy vọng là vậy."

definition: used to agree with what someone says or to answer "yes" to a question
exampleSentence: "So you live in Hue?" "That's right."
exampleTranslation: "Vậy bạn sống ở Huế à?" "Đúng rồi."

definition: used to say that you understand and agree with what someone has just said
exampleSentence: "This soup is really salty." "No kidding!"
exampleTranslation: "Món súp này mặn thật." "Đúng thế thật!"

definition: used when you are so surprised by what someone tells you that you do not completely believe it
translation: bạn đùa à, thật không đấy
exampleSentence: You're kidding! I won the prize?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đùa à! Tôi trúng giải thật sao?

definition: used to tell someone that what they suggest is so strange or silly that you cannot believe they are serious
exampleSentence: You must be joking! I'm not paying that much.
exampleTranslation: Bạn đang đùa đấy à! Tôi không trả nhiều như vậy đâu.

definition: used to say that you agree with a suggestion or that something seems reasonable; especially British English
exampleSentence: "I'd rather not go out tonight." "Fair enough."
exampleTranslation: "Tối nay tôi không muốn đi chơi lắm." "Cũng được thôi."
